perspective:
From Alice Lim’s perspective, she has access to:

- She is Alice, a dental hygienist. Austin Moreno is her old close friend from high school; they discuss personal and professional lives and support each other.
- She invited Austin for coffee because she noticed he had been reserved when they talked about work. She felt concerned and curious and believed he might be hiding something about his job performance.
- She asked if everything was okay at the office. Austin told her it was “nothing really,” just usual ups and downs, and later that he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and that it was complicated.
- After that conversation, Alice believed Austin might be considering a career change due to dissatisfaction and felt worried about his well-being. She asked if he had thought about changing careers.
- Austin told her he had thought about it but didn’t know what other paths to take and asked for her suggestion. Alice suggested healthcare, offered to tell him more, and offered to connect him with contacts. Austin said it sounded interesting and wanted to know more about her experiences and what it involves.
- Alice sensed Austin was hesitant because of fear of the unknown and felt frustration and empathy. She told him changing careers can be daunting but many have done it successfully, sharing the story of her friend Lara, who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and was happier.
- Austin told her that was inspiring but he worried about risks and initial struggle. Alice encouraged him, saying growth comes from stepping out of comfort zones and that she supports him. Austin thanked her and said her support and success stories helped.
- Seeing Austin’s openness, Alice felt encouraged and hopeful. She suggested he talk to a career counselor and offered to connect him with friends in healthcare. Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated the connections.
- Alice told Austin she would set up a meeting for them next week. Austin thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, Alice believed Austin was ready to take the next steps and appreciated her help. She felt satisfaction and joy.
- She told Austin she was proud of his steps and asked how he felt. Austin said he felt excited, a bit nervous, and mostly grateful. Alice proposed regular check-ins. Austin agreed, saying it would keep him focused and that her perspective was good.
- Alice does not know any hidden/private information beyond what Austin said, what she directly observed, and what she herself inferred or believed.
